title: Chapter 7197: Surprised?

Chapter 7197: Surprised?

Chapter 7197: Surprised?

Li Qiye effortlessly eliminated the tribulations feared by all, taking the seriousness out of the “calamity”.

“Still eternal?” Li Qiye asked Phoenix Queen’s group.

Chill coursed down their spine as they felt utterly insignificant under his gaze. They thought the high heaven’s blessing would keep them alive, granting them a form similar to the messengers in the past.

However, his destruction of the tribulations meant they could die as well.

“It appears you know nothing of my strength. What you all deem to be victory and survival is merely my path of karma.” Li Qiye said.

“You’re just walking through the motion?” Phoenix Queen didn’t believe him.

“What else can it be?” He asked.

“Are you sure everything is within expectation?” Genesis interjected since he had parts of the future.

“Show me the scene you are so confident in then.” Li Qiye smirked.

Genesis froze, feeling as if Li Qiye knew exactly what he wanted to do. If he knew this future, why would he let it happen, whether it be for karma or otherwise?

“Sir, the future has no place for you.” Genesis said: “The most powerful force won’t be you, not something you can imagine.”

“More than I can imagine? Then what about the high heaven?” Li Qiye smiled.

“...” Genesis staggered backward.

“Being able to visit the real future is not bad, worthy of being the future stone. However, you only saw a corner, not the whole truth.” Li Qiye said.

The others stared at Genesis who couldn’t respond. Nonetheless, he took a deep breath and said: “Although I can’t describe the future, I know what the strongest force will be, that’s enough.”

“What you say is contradictory because if you claim to know the future and the strongest power, why rely on the high heaven? Where is the high heaven in this future?” Li Qiye asked.

“So?” Heavenfall stared at Genesis.

“I didn’t see the high heaven, but I saw the power we need.” Genesis told the truth.

“How does it compare to the high heaven?” Phoenix Queen asked.

“Most likely stronger.” Genesis said.

The others didn’t believe him.

“Shouldn’t we find it now?” Phoenix Queen continued.

“It doesn’t exist currently.” Genesis said.

The others exchanged glances because this was their ace card.

“Trust me, we just need to move the present towards it.” Genesis continued.

“Fine, we shall trust.” The group agreed.

“Have we prepared everything properly?” Genesis asked.

The group nodded.

“Sir, are you ready for the future?” Genesis asked.

“Sure, show me.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Shall we begin to bring about your end?” Genesis said, summoning Heavencrush next to him.

“Start.” He told his allies.

The group carefully conjured a sealed dimension with a cloud trapped within.

“Oh?” Li Qiye’s eyes narrowed.

“Are you surprised, Sir?” Phoenix Queen asked.

“You all can’t seal it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Yes, it was just too curious and was sealed by the avatar.” Phoenix Queen said.

During Heaven Pit, the cloud wanted to watch the fight. The heavenly avatar noticed and sealed it.

“Looks like this desired future is guided by the high heaven.” Li Qiye said: “But you didn’t see the high heaven.”
